description: When the agent status is cleared and no non-agent event ever carried a status, the thread status is null with source collector, no reason and no attention.
contract: ADR-0017 (2d4dcc2 + QA spec gaps) decision 6 Precedence ("If there is no such status, the status is null"; "the source is collector")

steps.note: agent blocked is the first status in the thread
status-less task.started clears; no collector status exists
